whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Best Yoga & Zumba,

I noticed your dance and fitness classes near Malhi Pakri in Kankarbagh have great local energy, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new student admissions and trial bookings.

Maine aapke studio ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, Zumba & Yoga batch timings, aur class gallery integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/bestyogazumba

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Best Yoga & Zumba Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke fitness studio ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp trial bookings and batch schedules for Kankarbagh students. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact batch timings aur actual studio photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
